groups.title: Rug layouts (issue 166)
groups.blurb: Marc picked layouts C (wide living area) and D (under the bed), and wants the main and the bed rugs to be different designs. The designs marked IN THE GAME are built (main: striped, kilim, shag, jute, medallion; bed: green field, braided, diamond, cotton, vintage); the others are candidates and are not in the game. Each design is drawn over the real room in the game's order: floor, walls, rug, then furniture and the player, at 1x and as an 8x crop. The designs are my own stylized pixels.

groups.title: Alebrije (issue 167)
groups.blurb: Alebrijes are fantastical painted creatures, so any of these could be the one on the desk. Each shows the SMALL in-room sprite (at most 10 wide by 8 tall, foot on row 12, the desk's right corner) and the 48x48 CLOSE-UP the Examine card (issue 173, a later stage) will show. The close-up is candidate-only art; the small one is the simplified version of it. Palette only, no text. Pick a letter and the chosen small sprite replaces the owl (same file name and id trinket-alebrije, with the name and note below).

candidates.label: The owl now in the game: a dark body with white dots, big eyes, a pink beak, a plum flower and teal wing tips.
candidates.name: ALEBRIJE
candidates.note: A PAINTED WOODEN OWL WITH OPINIONS. IT KEEPS THEM TO ITSELF.

candidates.label: A plain cat: a sitting tangerine cat, a green-masked face with yellow eyes, a pink flower on its chest, white dots and a ringed tail.
candidates.name: ALEBRIJE CAT
candidates.note: IT SITS LIKE IT OWNS THE FLOWER. IT DOES.

candidates.label: A cat with wings: the same cat with a teal wing and a plum wing, feathered in sky and pink.
candidates.name: WINGED ALEBRIJE
candidates.note: IT HAS WINGS. IT HAS NEVER USED THEM IN FRONT OF YOU.

candidates.label: A cat-fish: the cat's head over a scaled teal body with pink side fins and a plum tail fin.
candidates.name: CAT FISH ALEBRIJE
candidates.note: HALF CAT, HALF FISH, ALL OPINION ABOUT THE BATH.

candidates.label: A cat with antlers and a dragon tail: butter antlers, a green tail with spikes, a pink chest flower.
candidates.name: ANTLERED ALEBRIJE
candidates.note: ANTLERS, A DRAGON TAIL AND THE CALM OF A CAT.

groups.title: Record stand (issue 172)
groups.blurb: The first replacement furniture. Each candidate is 16x16 in the room palette, the same footprint and the same near top-down view as the stand now (a back edge along the top, the top surface, a front, feet), drawn in the real room at the stand's place (col 9, row 7, against the south wall). The stand keeps its name and sprite name in the game, so the record player's task and its music notes still find it. None of these is in the game; the one you pick becomes the item that arrives as a delivery, and the stand you have now goes to the inventory. Say the letter, or say you want something else. Orientation (Marc, 2026-11-25): the stand is used from the north, so its front (records, doors, latches) faces north, the top of the sprite, like the stand now; the back toward the wall is plain. The gramophone (F to F6) did not read at 16x16 in this viewpoint and is not shipping.

current.label: The stand now: a back row of record spines and a turntable on a black top.

candidates.label: A wooden crate on legs, the front facing north (the top of the sprite): record spines in the thin north strip, the open turntable deck on the tan top, the plain back toward the wall.

A wire rack, front facing north: steel wires with records between them in the north strip, the turntable on the steel top, the plain back toward the wall. Reads more as a small metal unit than a wire rack.
A low wooden cabinet, front facing north: the two knobbed doors in the thin north strip, the turntable on the oak top, the plain back toward the wall.
A turntable cabinet, front facing north: a thin walnut front with a grille and knobs, the pale dust cover lying over the platter and hinged at the back (the wall side).

A pink suitcase record player: latches on the north strip, the cream deck with platter and tonearm facing the player, the lid hinged at the wall side and open toward the wall (its grille faces north).
The same suitcase in cream with a teal deck, the same way round.

NOT SHIPPING (old viewpoint, a side or front-facing horn that did not read). An old gramophone: a short brass horn at the back (a compromise: a real horn does not fit 16x16, so it is a short wide flare that reads more as a brass bell), an oak box top with a round platter and a hand crank on the right, short feet.

Gramophone, horn in side view: a tall brass cone rising to the upper right from the back of a low oak box, platter on top, crank at the right. The horn's silhouette is the one people recognise; this is the one that ships as the gramophone.

NOT SHIPPING (old viewpoint, a side or front-facing horn that did not read). Gramophone, big bright horn facing you from the back with a dark inner ring and throat. Reads as a brass bowl or pan on a box.

NOT SHIPPING (old viewpoint, a side or front-facing horn that did not read). A small table-top wind-up player: a small horn on the left, a cream box with a platter and a crank. The horn is too small to read.
